description.value: Redford Motel & RV has operated in Port Alberni for over 40 years, offering 34 rooms that range from single queen kitchenettes to full kitchen suites and extended-stay apartments, alongside RV grounds. The property sits in the Port Alberni Valley surrounded by mountains, lakes, and rivers, making it a practical base for cyclists exploring central Vancouver Island. An on-site restaurant, Dimitri's, has been serving pizza since 1980.

address.value: 3723 Redford St, Port Alberni, BC V9Y 3S3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for redfordmotel.ca is live and content-rich, confirming the motel's name, address, phone, and email match OSM exactly. The site describes 34 rooms with various suite types and an on-site pizza restaurant (Dimitri's, since 1980), but contains no mention of bike storage, laundry, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-specific amenities, so those are left null. A secondary phone number (250-724-4522) appears only in the holiday-hours popup and differs from the main line — flagged as a concern.
concerns: Holiday-hours popup cites a different phone number (250-724-4522) not listed elsewhere on the site or in OSM — may be a secondary office line or a data entry error; worth verifying.
COVID-19 information panel still visible on the site and references 2021 holiday hours alongside 2024 hours, suggesting the website is only partially maintained.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, long-established motel that is actively operating with online booking, matching OSM data confirmed by its own website. Useful to touring cyclists as an accommodation stop in Port Alberni.
